system.description: When a fire is needed and nothing is around to create a one, many people turn to a Fire Rod- a 10-cm hollow plastic tube that has two chambers, each filled with a chemical that is inert on it's own. When the two chemicals are mixed, they combine to become a highly volatile substance that ignites within seconds. A Fire Rod burns for 2d8 minutes without any additional fuel. Adding wood or other combustible material keeps the fire burning longer.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
